verify_email.subject: Confirm your email for Attentive
verify_email.body:
Hi {{.FirstName}},

Please confirm your email address so you can sign in:
{{.Link}}

This link works for 24 hours. If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.
reset_password.subject: Reset your Attentive password
reset_password.body:
Hi {{.FirstName}},

Use this link to choose a new password:
{{.Link}}

This link works for 1 hour. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
booking_confirmed.subject: Your session is booked ({{.Code}})
booking_changed.subject: Your session has moved ({{.Code}})
booking_cancelled.subject: Your session was cancelled ({{.Code}})
booking_cancelled.body:
Hi {{.FirstName}},

The session on {{.Date}} at {{.Time}} with {{.Psychologist}} has been cancelled.

You can book a new time whenever you are ready:
{{.Link}}
reminder.subject: Reminder: your session on {{.Date}}
follow_up.subject: Thinking of you
staff_booking_changed.subject: Schedule change: {{.Code}}
urgent_recovery.subject: Recover your Attentive request {{.Code}}
urgent_received.subject: Attentive request received - {{.Code}}
urgent_received.body:
Your request has been saved. Booking Code: {{.Code}}. Please wait for staff confirmation. Reopen your confirmation and QR code using the notification bell in the same browser where you submitted the request. Secure guest access lasts 30 days.
{{.Link}}
client_access.subject: Your Attentive access link
client_access.body:
Staff have requested account activation or email verification with your consent. Open this single-use link, valid for 24 hours, to continue. Your existing password will remain in place for an email address update.
{{.Link}}
verification.title: A little closer to your first session.
verification.body: Thank you for creating your Attentive account. Confirm your email address to securely sign in and manage your appointments.
verification.expiry: This secure link expires in 24 hours and can only be used once.
verification.ignore: If you did not create this account, you can safely ignore this email.
